title: Screen: browser-only title–abstract screening with active learning — reproducible benchmark
description: Frozen copy of Screen, an offline, browser-only title–abstract screening tool from the allmeta collection (commit 421ba13), together with everything needed to re-run its published benchmark: 19 labelled systematic-review screening datasets (15 Cohen 2006, fetched and SHA-256 verified; 4 SYNERGY, CC-BY 4.0) and the Nagtegaal 2019 de-duplication dataset (CC0); a headless harness that runs the app's own code unchanged; the ASReview 2.2 comparator (Naive Bayes and SVM); the de-duplication benchmark; and the analysis that regenerates the article's tables, figures and statistics and checks each number against the published value. One command (python reproduce.py) re-runs everything; a Dockerfile and pinned dependencies make the environment reproducible.
